worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.summary: A low bound that borrows the force of nearby brush: it leaps tick by tick along the aim, strikes the first enemy in its path, carries it along, and raises the user's Speed on a landed hit; launching from brush makes the bound heavier and the Speed gain bigger.
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.use.0: Burst out of the brush for a surprise strike
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.use.1: Close the gap to a farther foe with a sudden strike
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.use.2: Boost Speed, then run the new speed down
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.description: Bound low along the aim, feet rising up to about %4$s blocks; the first enemy struck takes about %1$s physical damage. One bound covers up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick, landing early if terrain blocks it.
A hit carries the target %2$s blocks along the bound; when the hit lands, the user's Speed rises %1$s stage(s) (one more when launched from brush), lasting until combat ends. Hit radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.overshoot.o: Through the brush: after the hit, keep skidding past to land behind the target; the landing is deeper in.
Pull up: stop right in front of the target on a hit, steadier footing to keep pressing.
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
On: after the hit, keep skidding to land behind the target. Off: pull up in front of it.
Only bound out when the foe is within this range; smaller stays on top of it, larger leaps from farther.
On: prefer to bound when there is brush underfoot for a heavier dash and an extra Speed stage. Off: only distance and threat matter, with no detours to reach brush.
worldcombat.skill.trailblaze.description: Launching with plants, flowers or leaves in the brush around the take-off spot adds force: a heavier dash and one more Speed stage. Open ground works too, just without that extra push.
